statement: The correspondence record incorrectly lists the reviewer (t.okonkwo@riverbend.edu) as the recipient for a decision letter that contains author identities, which would violate the double-blind review. The letter must go to the corresponding author instead.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the recipient field is incorrect and would breach double-blind anonymity, and supplies the correct recipient ("must go to the corresponding author instead").
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
